query:
SELECT r.id
                 FROM   requests.requests r
                 JOIN   requests.turn_origins tor ON tor.id = r.turn_origin_id AND tor.code = 'subagent'
                 WHERE  r.session_id         = $1
                   AND  r.agent_instance_id  = $3
                   AND  r.created_at         < $2
                 ORDER  BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC
                 LIMIT  1
